The '''Ferrous Aurora Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], travel through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was considered to be dangerous, due to a presence of [[Ni'lyahin Smugglers]].<ref name="Sony" />

{{Neb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ferrous Aurora Nebula appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ferrous Aurora Nebula was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

While originally being located withing the Yavin system,<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> the nebula was placed in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] by the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', later acknowledged that the placement in the Online Companion was erroneous.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2025.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-09-17}}</ref>
